resources.string: Quicker AI check of digital PDFs

When every page of a PDF holds its own exact text, the AI checks only the supplier, the date and number, and the totals: at most 30 seconds per invoice. The lines are still checked by their sums. Leave it off until the owner says yes.
Skip the AI on digital invoices that add up

When a PDF holds its own exact text and every amount checks out (each line, the taxable amount, VAT and the total), the AI is not needed: much faster for files of many invoices. Photos, scans and anything that does not add up are still checked by the AI.
